features.title: Rename edge_pct to market_prob across Radar UI
features.user_visible_behavior: The Radar no longer labels implied market probability as 'edge' anywhere in the UI (KPI bar, grid, filters, sort).
verification: grep -rn 'edge_pct|\.confidence' lib/types.ts components/radar/ components/pipeline/ app/radar/ (must return zero hits outside AIConfig.min_edge_pct)
features.notes: AIConfig.min_edge_pct and app/settings/page.tsx intentionally excluded — tracked separately as sprint-1-bis-settings-keys.

features.title: Retain per-bookmaker prices in _find_best_odds()
features.user_visible_behavior: No direct user-visible change. Internal: each outcome in the pipeline now carries book_prices[] (bookmaker + price) alongside the existing best price, as the data foundation for Sprint 1c scoring.
verification: docker compose run --rm api pytest tests/test_pipeline.py tests/test_picks.py -v
Must show 12/12 passing (4 pre-existing TestPredictor + 8 TestFindBestOdds)
features.notes: price field unchanged for backward compat with _process_odds. No Pick model columns added, no Alembic migration. Merge also cleaned an unrelated config.py drift (world_cup_sport_slug) that had accidentally entered the branch from a stale local main — resolved by syncing to origin/main's c848e1b before merge.

features.title: Calculate consensus_std, best_vs_avg, breadth_count from book_prices
features.user_visible_behavior: Radar grade (A/B/C) is based on a real confidence score (bookmaker consensus + best-line deviation + market breadth) instead of a fixed implied_prob threshold.
verification: Manual check: grade assignment no longer reads config['min_implied_prob_class_a/b'] directly in _process_odds
features.notes: Depends on sprint-1b-book-prices (passing). Requires deciding whether confidence_score is persisted (new Pick column + Alembic migration) or computed at read time only.

features.title: Fix disconnected Settings panel config keys
features.user_visible_behavior: Editing Min Edge, Min Grade, Max Picks/Day, or Unit Size in /settings actually changes pipeline behavior on the next run.
verification: Change a value in /settings, trigger a pipeline run, confirm the effect via runner.py's _load_config() output
